{{Top|leg}}
The '''Energy Directional Scrambler''' was a vital part of the [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]] built as part of the [[NOVA]] project. It was made by [[Santhe/Sienar Technologies]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. It was destroyed or disabled by a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] along with all the other components of the device.<ref name="ML">''[[Mission to Lianna]]''</ref> Later, Santhe/Sienar recreated the Scrambler and had a breakthrough in one of its major subsystems, the polarity-charged [[flux refractor]].<ref name="SV">{{JournalCite|4|Surprise Visit}}</ref>
